rationale: Both legs are already-tested archive components built on the same five-year R&D+advertising stock, so the pairing is largely mechanical overlap (the hidden-capital leg partly re-selects what the restated-denominator leg already penalizes) and is unlikely to add information beyond the two ~4% alpha parents.

This is a near-cosmetic re-normalization of the already-tested OrganicCredibleInnovatorConjunction (organic share replaced by NEG(intan/at)), and the stated motivation is internally inconsistent because IND_RANK of NEG(intan/at) inherits exactly the same intan=0 tie mass the proposal claims to fix.

Sales-growth stability is a genuinely distinct demand-side validation channel (not the earnings-level-scaled stability leg already tested), the expression matches the hypothesis, and the three-way conjunction is economically coherent even if coverage will be thin.

Stability of the intangible investment rate is an untested second-moment property with a plausible capital-formation rationale, though the claimed orthogonality to the level leg is doubtful since ratio volatility mechanically scales with ratio level, so incremental power over the existing credibility+intensity pair may be small.

This is precisely the cosmetic MIN-to-MUL structural swap already run in the archive (MonotoneInnovatorCashGradient vs CashValidatedInnovatorConjunction, which gave essentially identical results), so it embodies no new economic claim and predictably yields a near-duplicate of the existing champion.

The profit-growth-minus-sales-growth wedge is a defensible non-rivalry/operating-leverage signature and distinct from the cost-side learning-curve leg, but it is close to a smoothed change-in-operating-margin (a well-worn margin-momentum construct) and GROWTH on oibdp is fragile when the base is near zero or negative.
